# Correlations

## Load data

```{r}

bds <- read_csv("data/questionnaires/8_reverse_coded/bds_8_reverse_coded.csv")
beq <- read_csv("data/questionnaires/8_reverse_coded/beq_8_reverse_coded.csv")
blp <- read_csv("data/questionnaires/8_reverse_coded/blp_8_reverse_coded.csv")
bsq <- read_csv("data/questionnaires/8_reverse_coded/bsq_8_reverse_coded.csv")
leapq <- read_csv("data/questionnaires/8_reverse_coded/leapq_8_reverse_coded.csv")
lhq <- read_csv("data/questionnaires/8_reverse_coded/lhq_8_reverse_coded.csv")
lsbq <- read_csv("data/questionnaires/8_reverse_coded/lsbq_8_reverse_coded.csv")
# concatenate and remove ID

data_to_analyze_for_correlations <- list(blp, bsq, beq, leapq, lsbq, bds, lhq) %>%
  reduce(left_join, by = "id")

```

## L2 AoA items

```{r}

aoa_data <- data_to_analyze_for_correlations %>%
  dplyr::select(., blp_L2_aoa, leapq_aoa_L2, lsbq_L2_aoa, bds_aoa_L2_1, lhq_L2_aoa) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(.))

aoa_cormat <- rcorr(as.matrix(aoa_data))

write_csv(data.frame(aoa_cormat$r), "data/analysis/correlations/aoa/cormat_aoa_r.csv")
write_csv(data.frame(aoa_cormat$n), "data/analysis/correlations/aoa/cormat_aoa_n.csv")
write_csv(data.frame(aoa_cormat$P), "data/analysis/correlations/aoa/cormat_aoa_P_uncorrected.csv")

aoa_cormat_corrected <- p.adjust(aoa_cormat$P, method="bonferroni")
format(aoa_cormat_corrected, scientific = TRUE)

write_csv(data.frame(
            matrix(
              unlist(aoa_cormat_corrected), 
              nrow = 5,
              ncol = 5)
          ), 
          "data/analysis/correlations/aoa/cormat_aoa_P_corrected.csv", 
          col_names = FALSE)
```

## Proficiency items

### Speaking

```{r}

l2_speaking_data <- data_to_analyze_for_correlations %>%
  dplyr::select(.,
         blp = blp_L2_proficiency_speaking,
         leapq = leapq_L2_proficiency_speaking,
         lsbq = lsbq_L2_proficiency_speaking,
         lhq = lhq_L2_proficiency_speaking) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(.)) %>%
  mutate(lsbq = lsbq - 2) %>%
  mutate(lsbq = case_when(
    lsbq == -1 ~ 0,
    lsbq != -1 ~ lsbq
  ))

l2_speaking_cormat <- rcorr(as.matrix(l2_speaking_data))

write_csv(data.frame(l2_speaking_cormat$r), "data/analysis/correlations/speaking/cormat_l2spk_r.csv")
write_csv(data.frame(l2_speaking_cormat$n), "data/analysis/correlations/speaking/cormat_l2spk_n.csv")
write_csv(data.frame(l2_speaking_cormat$P), "data/analysis/correlations/speaking/cormat_l2spk_P_uncorrected.csv")

l2_speaking_cormat_corrected <- p.adjust(l2_speaking_cormat$P, method="bonferroni")
format(l2_speaking_cormat_corrected, scientific = TRUE)

write_csv(data.frame(
            matrix(
              unlist(l2_speaking_cormat_corrected), 
              nrow = 4,
              ncol = 4)
          ), 
          "data/analysis/correlations/speaking/cormat_l2spk_P_corrected.csv", 
          col_names = FALSE)

describe(l2_speaking_data)
```

## L2 Usage

### Get correlation matrix and save it

```{r}
# These are the usage items..
usage_cols <- colnames(data_to_analyze_for_correlations)[str_detect(colnames(data_to_analyze_for_correlations), 'use')]

l1_items <- c("blp_L1_use_family",
              "blp_L1_use_friends",
              "blp_L1_use_school_work",
              "lhq_L1_use_tv_radio",
              "lhq_L1_use_reading",
              "bsq_use_l1_in_l2")

l2_usage_cols <- setdiff(usage_cols, l1_items)

usage_data_for_corr <- data_to_analyze_for_correlations %>%
  select(all_of(l2_usage_cols))
usage_cormat <- rcorr(as.matrix(usage_data_for_corr), type="pearson")

write_csv(data.frame(usage_cormat$r), "data/analysis/correlations/usage/cormat_usage_r.csv")
write_csv(data.frame(usage_cormat$n), "data/analysis/correlations/usage/cormat_usage_n.csv")
write_csv(data.frame(usage_cormat$P), "data/analysis/correlations/usage/cormat_usage_P_uncorrected.csv")

rmat_df <- data.frame(usage_cormat$r)
pmat_df <- data.frame(usage_cormat$P)

usage_cormat_corrected <- p.adjust(usage_cormat$P, method="bonferroni")

pmat_corrected_df <- data.frame(
            matrix(
              unlist(usage_cormat_corrected), 
              nrow = length(l2_usage_cols),
              ncol = length(l2_usage_cols)
            ))
colnames(pmat_corrected_df) <- l2_usage_cols


write_csv(pmat_corrected_df, 
          "data/analysis/correlations/usage/cormat_usage_P_corrected.csv", 
          col_names = TRUE)

count_0 <- sum(pmat_corrected_df == 0, na.rm=TRUE)
count_sig_1 <- sum(pmat_corrected_df < 0.001, na.rm=TRUE)
count_sig_2 <- sum(pmat_corrected_df < 0.01, na.rm=TRUE)
count_sig_3 <- sum(pmat_corrected_df < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE)

```

### Plot correlation matrix (all L2 items included)

```{r}

# Convert to long format

# r values
var_order_r <- as.factor(colnames(rmat_df))

df_r <- rmat_df %>%
  rownames_to_column("Var1") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Var1,
               names_to = "Var2",
               values_to = "r") %>%
  mutate(
    Var1 = factor(Var1, levels = var_order_r),
    Var2 = factor(Var2, levels = var_order_r),
    row = as.numeric(Var1),
    col = as.numeric(Var2),
    r = ifelse(col == row, NA, r)
  )

# adjusted p values
var_order_p <- as.factor(colnames(pmat_df))

df_p <- pmat_df %>%
  rownames_to_column("Var1") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Var1,
               names_to = "Var2",
               values_to = "p") %>%
  mutate(
    Var1 = factor(Var1, levels = var_order_p),
    Var2 = factor(Var2, levels = var_order_p),
    row = as.numeric(Var1),
    col = as.numeric(Var2),
    p = ifelse(col == row, NA, p)
  )

# merge p and r values into single data frame and derive significance lapel from p

merged_r_and_p <- merge(df_r, df_p, by=c("Var1", "Var2")) %>%
  select(Var1, Var2, r, p) %>%
  mutate(sig_label = case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "**",
    p < 0.01  ~ "*",
    p >= 0.01 ~ ""
  ))

#unique(merged_r_and_p$Var1)

better_names <- c("Express emotions",
                  "Reading",
                  "TV/radio",
                  "Praying",
                  "Internet",
                  "Movies",
                  "TV/radio",
                  "Lists/notes",
                  "Social media",

                  "Reading",

                  "Shop/restaurant",
                  "Extracurriculars",
                  "Religion",

                  "Infancy",
                  "Useful",
                  "L2 in L1",
                  "Counting",
                  "Alone",
                  "School/work",
                  "Friends",
                  "Family")

better_names_rev <- rev(better_names)

ggplot(merged_r_and_p, aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(color = "grey90") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue3",
    mid= "white",
    high = "firebrick",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-1, 1),
    na.value = "white"
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), size = 3.5, color="black") +

                                 hjust = 1,

  )
```

# MFA

## Run the MFA

```{r}

# Load data
bds_mfa <- read_csv("data/questionnaires/8_reverse_coded/bds_8_reverse_coded.csv")
beq_mfa <- read_csv("data/questionnaires/8_reverse_coded/beq_8_reverse_coded.csv")
blp_mfa <- read_csv("data/questionnaires/8_reverse_coded/blp_8_reverse_coded.csv")
bsq_mfa <- read_csv("data/questionnaires/8_reverse_coded/bsq_8_reverse_coded.csv")
leapq_mfa <- read_csv("data/questionnaires/8_reverse_coded/leapq_8_reverse_coded.csv")
lhq_mfa <- read_csv("data/questionnaires/8_reverse_coded/lhq_8_reverse_coded.csv")
lsbq_mfa <- read_csv("data/questionnaires/8_reverse_coded/lsbq_8_reverse_coded.csv")

# Concatenate in single data frame
mfa_input <- list(bds_mfa,
                  beq_mfa,
                  blp_mfa, 
                  bsq_mfa, 
                  leapq_mfa, 
                  lhq_mfa,
                  lsbq_mfa) %>%
  reduce(left_join, by = "id") %>%
  mutate(., id = NULL)

# Run the MFA
mfa_results <- MFA(mfa_input, 
               group = c(ncol(bds_mfa)   - 1,
                         ncol(beq_mfa)   - 1,
                         ncol(blp_mfa)   - 1,
                         ncol(bsq_mfa) - 1,
                         ncol(leapq_mfa)  - 1,
                         ncol(lhq_mfa)   - 1,
                         ncol(lsbq_mfa)   - 1
                         ), 
               type = c("s","s","s","s","s","s","s"),
               name.group= c("BDS", "BEQ", "BLP", "BSwQ", "LEAP-Q", "LHQ", "LSBQ"),
               graph = TRUE)

write_rds(mfa_results, "data/analysis/mfa/mfa_results.rds")
```

## Pretty plot for groups representation

### Set up the plot

```{r}

coords <- mfa_results$group$coord

questionnaires <- c("BDS", "BEQ", "BLP", "BSwQ", "LEAP-Q", "LHQ", "LSBQ")

                coords[2,1],
                coords[3,1],
                coords[4,1],
                coords[5,1],
                coords[6,1],
                coords[7,1])
dim_2_vals <- c(coords[1,2],
                coords[2,2],
                coords[3,2],
                coords[4,2],
                coords[5,2],
                coords[6,2],
                coords[7,2])
dim_3_vals <- c(coords[1,3],

                coords[3,3],
                coords[4,3],
                coords[5,3],
                coords[6,3],
```

## Characterizing the dimensions

### Dim.1 (Usage)

```{r}

#fviz_contrib(mfa_results, "partial.axes",  top = 7, axes = 1)
#fviz_contrib(mfa_results, "group", top = 7, axes = 1)
fviz_contrib(mfa_results, "quanti.var", top = 30, axes = 1)

# Extract Dim.1 scores for all participants
dim1_scores <- mfa_results$ind$coord[, "Dim.1"]

# get 10 columns that contribute most to dimension
dim1_contrib <- mfa_results$quanti.var$contrib[, "Dim.1"]
top_contributors <- names(sort(dim1_contrib, decreasing = TRUE))[1:10]

# Determine quartile cutoffs
q1_cutoff <- quantile(dim1_scores, 0.25) # Bottom quartile
q3_cutoff <- quantile(dim1_scores, 0.75) # Top quartile

# Identify participants in each quartile
bottom_quartile <- dim1_scores <= q1_cutoff
top_quartile <- dim1_scores >= q3_cutoff

# Extract the dataset containing the top contributing variables
data_matrix <- mfa_results$call$X # The original data used in MFA

# Select only the columns corresponding to top contributors
selected_data <- data_matrix[, top_contributors]

# Compute mean values for top and bottom quartile groups
means_bottom <- colMeans(selected_data[bottom_quartile, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
means_top <- colMeans(selected_data[top_quartile, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

# Create a dataframe
result_df_dim1 <- data.frame(
  Variable = top_contributors,
  Mean_Bottom_Quartile = round(means_bottom, 2),
  Mean_Top_Quartile = round(means_top, 2)
)

# Print the result
print(result_df_dim1)

write_csv(result_df_dim1, "data/analysis/mfa/dim1_lo-hi.csv")

```
